{
  "name": "downrange",
  "version": "1.1.2",
  "description": "A band, pane, and /downrange table: progress, ETA, and last output for Claude Code background shells and Monitor watches, tool activity for subagents, state for workflows, and the next /loop wakeup.",
  "author": {
    "name": "dot-agi"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/dot-agi/downrange",
  "repository": "https://github.com/dot-agi/downrange",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/downrange/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/downrange/blob/main/docs/usage.md",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/downrange#privacy",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "claude-code",
    "background-tasks",
    "status",
    "progress",
    "eta"
  ],
  "icon": "./docs/images/icon.png",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "band": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Band above the prompt",
      "description": "Show a one-line status band above the prompt while background work runs.",
      "default": true
    },
    "answerStatusPrompts": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Answer status prompts locally",
      "description": "When Claude is idle and background work runs, answer an exact status prompt such as \"status?\" with the /downrange table instead of sending it to Claude. Send the same prompt again within 60 seconds to ask Claude.",
      "default": false
    },
    "genericRatios": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Progress from any ratio",
      "description": "Also read progress from a ratio in any place in the output, such as \"loss 12/40\" or \"Retry 1 of 3\". Off: only known formats count, such as \"45%\", \"[3/7]\", \"Step 3 of 7\", or a count after a progress bar. On shows progress for more jobs, and more false readings, such as a date in \"Released 10/11\".",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
